title: Capt. Picard "economics of the future are somewhat different"
summary: A short edited clip from Star Trek: First Contact in which Captain Picard explains that humanity of the future no longer works for money or possessions. Added context frames the second part of the clip.
why: HN uses it as shorthand for post-scarcity economics, typically as a contrast to money-driven projects like crypto.

quote.text: Let's just listen to the man himself for a second
